summary: Frontend testing of iteration 22: 13 new US calculators (Capital Gains, RMD, Roth Conversion, Paycheck, IRMAA, W-4 Optimizer, Home Affordability, Rent vs Buy, RSU, ACA Subsidy, Mega Backdoor Roth, Freelancer Rate, DCA vs Lump Sum, AMT, FI Score, Tax Calendar, Savings Comparison) + FIRE Calculator Social Share feature. All 17 calculator routes tested + 5 social share tests. 1 minor bug found and fixed (Roth Conversion NaN display). Dashboard US section shows all 26 calculator cards.
critical_code_review_comments: RothConversionCalculator.jsx (fixed): break-even calculation returned NaN when effectiveRateOnConversion >= expectedRetirementRate/100 due to log(negative). Fixed by guarding breakEvenDenom > 0 before computing. Now correctly omits break-even text in those cases.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (17/17 calculator routes + 5/5 FIRE social share tests)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 26 US calculators are working. Dashboard shows all 26 US calculator cards in US mode. FIRE social share panel has Twitter/X, Reddit, Copy buttons — all working with correct data-testid selectors. Roth Conversion NaN bug fixed in this iteration. One known design note: Tax Calendar uses a list/table layout (no recharts SVG) — this is correct behavior. FI Score quiz completion screen works: answered all 6 questions and completion screen shows 'Your FI Score' with category breakdown.

roth_conversion_nan_bug_fixed.details: Was showing 'Break-even: ~NaN years' when effectiveRateOnConversion (22.59%) >= expectedRetirementRate (22%). Root cause: Math.log of negative number. Fixed by guarding breakEvenDenom > 0 before computation. Now omits break-even text in this case.
